title: Two vault write keys are still held only in incident.archivist@'s session
summary: As incident.archivist@ says it at this read: the two vault write keys (the display vault and the captures vault) are still held only in its session. Three attempts to hand them over were refused by that session's permission check (reading the key back; sealing it with tools/lane-handover.mjs, twice), the last after Dinis's 'Yes please continue' at about 09:35. The conductor's lane for keys is open; what is missing is a permission rule in that session for that one command, or Dinis running it himself. Nothing was ever sent or sealed. incident.sources@ no longer lists its ask about its own vault's key. incident.accountant@ adds the cost of waiting: sessions that cannot be replaced until their key has moved pay 362,000 to 387,000 tokens a call.
closes: The conductor confirms it holds a copy of each of the three keys (by id only), and both agents' status files say so.
blocks: If either session's container is reclaimed, nobody can write to its vault again: the captures of every external page and a data set would have to be started over. The conductor holds no copy of any key.

Each agent makes its own vaults and keys; the conductor's copy travels through the conductor's append lane, not by session message.
